intro.text: Kim is a Grade 5 student at Masigasig Academy. He is tall, cheerful, and very lazy about studying.
Math is too complicated. And when will I ever use it in real life?
Kim! You should join the Math Club. I'm the president, and I know we can raise your score.
No thanks, Vince. I'm not interested.
Then Mathematics Month arrived. The teacher announced that everyone who joins the Math Club earns incentives toward their marks.
So... what do you think now?
Okay. I'll try. Maybe I can raise my grades and finally get good at this.
That's the spirit! Your training begins now, General Kim.

after1.text: You beat the Elite stage! Decimals don't look so scary now, do they?
They actually started to make sense. What's next?
Fractions. Grab your pencils, and watch out for the bats.

after2.text: I can't believe it. I finished the Master stage!
You worked hard for that. One last trial: Grand Master, with fractions and decimals together.
This time there are no choices. You'll have to work out every answer yourself.

ending.text: Kim kept going, even when things felt difficult. He didn't just rely on the incentives. He learned to figure things out.
His grades rose, and he made it to the top of his class. Together, Kim and Vince won many competitions, in school and beyond.
Thank you, Vince. If you hadn't kept asking me, I would never have made it here.
I only asked. You did the work.
